description: This file defines an abstract class `issueTrackerInterface` for integrating with various issue tracking systems in a software testing framework. It includes methods for configuration, database connection management, issue retrieval, URL generation, status checking, and other common issue tracker interactions. The class is designed to be extended by specific implementations for different issue tracking systems.

classes.name: issueTrackerInterface
classes.description: An abstract class serving as a base for connecting and interacting with various issue tracking systems within the TestLink framework. It provides common functionalities such as configuration management, database connection, and issue information retrieval, meant to be extended by concrete classes for specific issue tracking platforms.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the interface with a given type, configuration XML, and name, establishing a database connection if configuration is valid.

methods.name: canCreateViaAPI
methods.description: Indicates whether creating issues via API is supported; default returns false.

methods.name: canAddNoteViaAPI
methods.description: Indicates whether adding notes via API is supported; default returns false.

methods.name: getCfg
methods.description: Returns the current configuration object for the issue tracker.

methods.name: setCfg
methods.description: Sets and parses the XML configuration string, converting it to a SimpleXML object, with internal error handling.

methods.name: getMyInterface
methods.description: Returns the interface configuration property from the loaded config.

methods.name: getBugIDMaxLength
methods.description: Returns the maximum length for bug IDs as used in the GUI; defaults to 64.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Establishes a database connection to the issue tracking system based on configuration details.

methods.name: isConnected
methods.description: Returns whether the system is currently connected to the issue tracker.

methods.name: disconnect
methods.description: Closes the database connection if active.

methods.name: checkBugIDSyntaxNumeric
methods.description: Validates that a bug ID string is numeric and positive.

methods.name: checkBugIDSyntaxString
methods.description: Validates that a bug ID string does not contain forbidden characters and is not empty.

methods.name: buildViewBugLink
methods.description: Generates an HTML link for viewing a specific bug in the issue tracker.

methods.name: getEnterBugURL
methods.description: Returns the URL for entering new bugs into the issue tracker.

methods.name: buildViewBugURL
methods.description: Constructs a URL to view a specific issue ID.

methods.name: getIssueStatusCode
methods.description: Returns the status code of an issue, or false if not found.

methods.name: getIssueStatusVerbose
methods.description: Returns a human-readable status description of an issue.

methods.name: getIssueSummary
methods.description: Retrieves the summary text of a specific issue.

methods.name: getCfgTemplate
methods.description: Abstract method to be implemented by subclasses, providing a configuration template.

methods.name: checkEnv
methods.description: Static method to verify the environment supports the interface; default always OK.

methods.name: setResolvedStatusCfg
methods.description: Configures the internal representation of resolved statuses based on the configuration.

methods.name: getResolvedStatusCfg
methods.description: Returns the current resolved status configuration.

methods.name: getBugStatus
methods.description: Returns the verbose status of a bug by issue ID.

methods.name: checkBugIDExistence
methods.description: Checks whether a given bug ID exists in the issue tracking system.

methods.name: buildStatusHTMLString
methods.description: Generates an HTML string representing the status code, optionally decorated.

methods.name: getBugSummaryMaxLength
methods.description: Returns the maximum bug summary length for GUI display; defaults to 120.

methods.name: normalizeBugID
methods.description: Normalizes bug IDs, default implementation returns the input as-is.
